Current protocol templates for pharmacoepidemiology RWE studies are optimized for hypothesis-evaluating studies with pre-specified analyses and well-defined study components e.g., ENCEPP, HARPER. However, they do not adequately address the iterative development, validation, and deployment considerations unique to AI/ML-based health research
